facts.text: Jon is determined to complete his dance studio project despite the challenges involved.

evidence.quote: Looking for the right place and getting everything ready has been a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, but I'm determined to make it work.

facts.text: Jon plans to use Marley flooring for his dance studio because it provides the right balance of grip and movement.

evidence.quote: I'm after Marley flooring, which is what dance studios usually use. It's great 'cause it's grippy but still lets you move, plus it's tough and easy to keep clean.

facts.text: Gina encourages Jon to believe in himself and to take breaks to destress during the process of building his dance studio.

evidence.quote: Believe in yourself, Jon! The process may be tough, but you got this. Push through and it'll be worth it. Don't forget to take breaks and dance it out when you need to destress!

facts.text: Jon acknowledges Gina's support and intends to make time to dance and vent as part of the process.

evidence.quote: Glad I have you in my corner! Gotta make time to dance and vent, that's for sure.
